title: Just B | 7BR Rental on Seacrest Beach 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Just B is a 7BR luxury estate in Seacrest Beach 30A with private pool, spa, pickleball court and Gulf views. Sleeps 24. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: Just B by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 35 B Street, Inlet Beach, FL Description: Tucked away on the east end of 30A, Just B is a private 10,000+ square foot sanctuary sitting on 1/3 acre of property that delivers an elevated escape designed for unforgettable 30A vacations. Among the finest 30A luxury rentals, this newly constructed home offers the space, privacy, and resort-style amenities discerning travelers expect, all just a short walk from the emerald waters and white-sand beaches. Ideally located near Alys and Rosemary Beaches, it’s a standout choice for those exploring Seacrest Beach vacation rentals and premier vacation rentals on 30A. This estate features a grand main house, oversized carriage house, expansive pool and spa, private regulation-size pickleball court, fitness room, and a third-floor bar, game, and media space with stunning Gulf views. Those searching for 30A vacation homes with private pools will love this stunning property. Each bedroom offers a refined private retreat with ensuite baths and custom finishes, making this one-of-a-kind 30A luxury vacation rental the ideal setting for an unforgettable stay along 30A. Home Highlights: - Newly constructed coastal estate spanning over 10,000+ square feet of impeccably designed indoor and outdoor living space. - Rare private, gated beach access just 0.1 miles away, an effortless three-minute walk to the Gulf. - Breathtaking panoramic Gulf views from multiple vantage points throughout the home. - Set on a secluded 1/3 acre bordered by protected natural habitat, ensuring exceptional privacy and tranquility. - Private regulation-size cushioned pickleball court for resort-style recreation. - *Luxury heated pool complemented by an expansive 12-person spa. - Multiple outdoor entertaining spaces including a fireplace, courtyard, and professional outdoor grill. - Private fitness room featuring a Tonal intelligent home gym system. - Full-size bar and dedicated media room designed for elevated entertaining. - Separate carriage house with full kitchen, ideal for guests or extended stays. - Electric vehicle charging station. - Ample on-site parking accommodating up to eight vehicles. - RV parking with utility connections. - Eight adult bikes provided for effortless coastal exploration. - Ground coffee and Keurig machine are available for your use. *Pool heat is available for an additional $300 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 24 7 Bedrooms / 8 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths Main House (Sleeps 20) First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Suite with Ensuite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Bedroom 2: Office with Sleeper Sofa with Ensuite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Living Room, Dining, Gourmet Kitchen (Ground Coffee Maker Available), Butler's Pantry, Half Bath - Private Backyard with Swimming Pool, 12- Person Hot Tub, Private Pickleball Court, Courtyard, Fireplace, Outdoor Kitchen - Laundry Room Second Floor: - Bedroom 3: King Suite, Den and Desk with Two Twin Sleepers with Ensuite Bathroom (sleeps 4) - Bedroom 4: King Suite with Ensuite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Bedroom 5: King Suite with Ensuite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Bedroom 6: Bunk Room Six Twin XL Beds with Ensuite Bathroom (sleeps 6) - Wet Bar with Keurig - Laundry Room Third Floor: - Bonus Sleeping Space Twin Bed (Sleeps 1) - Bonus Sleeping Space Twin Bed (Sleeps 1) - Full Size Bar with Seating and Shuffleboard - Media Room - Game Room - Video Gaming Room - Full Bathroom - Stunning Gulf Views via 2 Large Balconies Carriage House (sleeps 4) One Floor: - Bedroom 7: King Bed (sleeps 2) - Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) - Full Bathroom - Full Size Kitchen with Keurig - Laundry Room Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
